problem.subject: Router keeps rebooting overnight
problem.description: The router in the back office has rebooted itself every night this week, around 2am.

steps_taken: Uptime resets confirmed in the log. Firmware 9.2 is current.

prior_cases.subject: Wi-Fi drops in the back office every afternoon
prior_cases.description: The back office loses Wi-Fi for a few minutes most afternoons around 3pm.
prior_cases.resolution: Moved the 2.4 GHz radio to channel 11 and disabled auto channel selection.
